mapper.select: SELECT * FROM aim_ai_usage_daily WHERE usage_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY usage_date,provider_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO aim_ai_usage_daily(usage_date,provider_code,call_count,input_tokens,output_tokens,estimated_cost) VALUES(#{usageDate},#{providerCode},#{callCount},#{inputTokens},#{outputTokens},#{estimatedCost}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE call_count=call_count+VALUES(call_count), input_tokens=input_tokens+VALUES(input_tokens), output_tokens=output_tokens+VALUES(output_tokens), estimated_cost=estimated_cost+VALUES(estimated_cost)
